subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Planejar e produzir cartazes e folhetos para divulgar eventos da escola ou da comunidade, utilizando linguagem persuasiva e elementos textuais e visuais (tamanho da letra, leiaute, imagens) adequados ao gênero, considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto do texto.

components.description_pt: Usar linguagem persuasiva apropriada a cartazes e panfletos publicitários de eventos
components.description_en: Use persuasive language appropriate to posters and flyers publicizing events
components.cc_component_description: Select language and tone appropriate to a specific writing purpose and audience

components.description_pt: Selecionar elementos visuais e textuais como tamanho de fonte, layout e imagens apropriados ao gênero
components.description_en: Select visual and textual elements such as font size, layout, and images appropriate to the genre
components.cc_component_description: Incorporate formatting elements such as headings, graphics, or multimedia to aid reader comprehension

components.description_pt: Planejar e produzir cartaz ou panfleto considerando situação comunicativa e tema do evento
components.description_en: Plan and produce a poster or flyer considering the communicative situation and topic of the event
components.cc_component_description: Plan a writing piece by considering the purpose and intended audience before drafting

cc_matches.description: Introduce a topic clearly, previewing what is to follow; organize ideas, concepts, and information into broader categories; include formatting (e.g., headings), graphics (e.g., charts, tables), and multimedia when useful to aiding comprehension.
Produce clear and coherent writing in which the development and organization are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.

With some guidance and support from peers and adults, develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, focusing on how well purpose and audience have been addressed.
